datasets_evaluated.name: Eedi / NeurIPS 2020 Education Challenge Dataset
datasets_evaluated.host: Eedi / NeurIPS Competition Track / Microsoft Research
datasets_evaluated.license: Custom academic research license (Eedi Terms of Use)
datasets_evaluated.local_download_status: Paper downloaded locally to dataset/reference_materials/research_papers/NeurIPS_2020_Education_Challenge_Eedi.pdf (957 KB). Underlying 20M response logs require platform competition credentialing.
datasets_evaluated.suitability_for_relearn: HIGH INSPIRATION / LOW DIRECT CONTENT: Highly influential architectural model for 4-option diagnostic questions where distractors map to misconceptions. However, contains zero physics questions, so cannot be used as direct physics training data.

datasets_evaluated.name: Kaggle: Eedi - Mining Misconceptions in Mathematics (2024)
datasets_evaluated.license: Competition Data License / Apache 2.0 external subsets
datasets_evaluated.local_download_status: Competition documentation and schema reviewed. Download requires active Kaggle API token and competition acceptance.
datasets_evaluated.suitability_for_relearn: HIGH METHODOLOGICAL SUITABILITY: Demonstrates automated mapping of distractors to MisconceptionName and MisconceptionId. Re:Learn adapts this exact relational schema to Class 10 Physics.

datasets_evaluated.name: DIRECT Test (Determining and Interpreting Resistive Electric Circuits Concepts Test)
datasets_evaluated.host: PhysPort / NCSU PER Group / American Journal of Physics (Engelhardt & Beichner, 2004)
datasets_evaluated.license: PhysPort Verified Educator Controlled Access (Copyright AJP/AAPT)
datasets_evaluated.local_download_status: Public conceptual specifications and item blueprints reviewed via Compadre PER and academic literature. Raw 29-item test restricted to registered educators to preserve diagnostic security.
datasets_evaluated.subject_focus: DC Electric Circuits (High School & Introductory College)
datasets_evaluated.suitability_for_relearn: CRITICAL CONCEPTUAL FOUNDATION: Gold standard for circuit misconceptions (Constant Current Battery, Current Attenuation, Local Reasoning). Diagnostic questions in Re:Learn Electricity chapter directly implement DIRECT principles.

datasets_evaluated.name: AI2 ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
datasets_evaluated.host: Allen Institute for AI (Clark et al., 2018) via HuggingFace (allenai/ai2_arc)
datasets_evaluated.local_download_status: Verified download of sample records to dataset/external_resources_and_benchmarks/sample_external_records/arc_sample_physics.json.
datasets_evaluated.suitability_for_relearn: MODERATE: Contains rich general science question stems and distractors, but lacks misconception tagging on distractors (only provides correct answer key) and does not map to NCERT syllabus.
